I can raise roughly $276 by selling all three light blue houses and mortgaging them. That still cannot cover p2's orange or dark blue rent. I am essentially bankrupt.

Completing utilities would also double utility rent for them. I am now considering whether p2 might trade Boardwalk or an orange property for my holdings.
